name: Family
description: Family provides extraordinary resources, refuge, and support that shapes the character's life.

name: Family
description: Family frequently offers significant resources, information, or comfort.

name: Family
description: Family occasionally offers minor assistance or a place to rest.

name: Family
description: Family expectations or drama cause occasional minor complications.

name: Family
description: Family conflict or dependents create serious, recurring demands on time and energy.

name: Family
description: Deep family trauma or obligation pervades every aspect of the character's life.

name: Allies and Opponents
description: A powerful, always-available ally capable of major assistance in nearly any situation.

name: Allies and Opponents
description: An influential ally who regularly provides significant aid or information.

name: Allies and Opponents
description: A minor ally who offers occasional small favors or useful contacts.

name: Allies and Opponents
description: A minor opponent who causes occasional nuisances or social friction.

name: Allies and Opponents
description: A serious enemy who consistently works to impede the character's goals.

name: Allies and Opponents
description: A powerful, relentless enemy who is a constant and dangerous threat.

name: Financial
description: Vastly greater access to material resources than the average Cahokia citizen.

name: Financial
description: Significantly better financial standing; wealth checks are notably easier.

name: Financial
description: Slightly above average wealth; minor resource checks are a bit easier.

name: Financial
description: Slightly reduced wealth rank; minor resource checks are a bit harder.

name: Financial
description: Seriously limited material resources; significant financial strain.

name: Financial
description: Extreme poverty; the character struggles to meet even basic needs.

name: Spirit World Connection
description: The veil is constantly transparent; the spirit world is an everyday reality for the character.

name: Spirit World Connection
description: Strong attunement to spirits provides frequent and meaningful advantages.

name: Spirit World Connection
description: Mild awareness of the spirit world offers occasional useful insights.

name: Spirit World Connection
description: Mild resistance to spiritual matters; the spirit world feels distant and unreliable.

name: Spirit World Connection
description: Significant barrier between the character and the spirit world; serious disadvantage in spiritual matters.

name: Spirit World Connection
description: Completely walled off from the spiritual realm; spiritual interactions always fail or backfire.

name: Animal Connection
description: Profound bond with animals; creatures are consistently calm and cooperative in the character's presence.

name: Animal Connection
description: Strong affinity; animals frequently respond to the character's intentions and communication.

name: Animal Connection
description: Mild natural affinity; animals are slightly more at ease and readable.

name: Animal Connection
description: Animals are mildly uneasy around the character; minor tension in animal interactions.

name: Animal Connection
description: Animals consistently react with distrust or hostility; animal interactions are regularly dangerous.

name: Animal Connection
description: Animals universally flee or attack on sight; the character cannot safely be near most creatures.

name: Secrets
description: A secret that grants extraordinary access, power, or protection to those who hold it.

name: Secrets
description: A significant secret that provides ongoing advantages in resources or relationships.

name: Secrets
description: A minor secret that occasionally opens doors or provides small advantages.

name: Secrets
description: A small secret with minor social risk if exposed.

name: Secrets
description: A dangerous secret that could cost the character relationships, livelihood, or safety.

name: Secrets
description: An explosive secret whose exposure would be catastrophic and potentially life-ending.

name: Quirks
description: An extraordinary innate ability — like eidetic memory — that consistently benefits a wide range of situations.

name: Quirks
description: An unusual talent, such as ambidexterity, that regularly aids multiple skill checks.

name: Quirks
description: A minor quirk that provides occasional small situational advantages.

name: Quirks
description: A minor quirk that occasionally causes small problems or social awkwardness.

name: Quirks
description: A significant quirk that consistently hinders certain categories of action.

name: Quirks
description: A pervasive quirk that affects nearly every aspect of the character's daily life.

name: Curses and Blessings
description: A profound blessing — from an ancestor, charm, or fate — that provides near-constant extraordinary luck.

name: Curses and Blessings
description: A strong blessing that frequently tips fate in the character's favor under the right conditions.

name: Curses and Blessings
description: A mild blessing that occasionally nudges luck slightly toward the positive.

name: Curses and Blessings
description: A minor curse that occasionally causes small bouts of bad luck.

name: Curses and Blessings
description: A strong curse that regularly causes significant misfortune under specific conditions.

name: Curses and Blessings
description: A devastating curse from a spirit or ancient wrong that pervades every aspect of existence.

name: Addictions
description: A controlled dependency that paradoxically opens doors — rare suppliers or communities few others can access.

name: Addictions
description: A manageable dependency that occasionally creates useful connections or access.

name: Addictions
description: A mild dependency that rarely intrudes on daily life.

name: Addictions
description: A mild addiction that requires feeding every few days; minor penalties if denied.

name: Addictions
description: A serious addiction requiring daily satisfaction; significant penalties without supply.

name: Addictions
description: A consuming addiction that must be fed constantly and dominates the character's every decision.

name: Notoriety
description: Fame: universally recognized for extraordinary deeds; near every social interaction is colored by renown.

name: Notoriety
description: Fame: well-known positive reputation that regularly opens doors and lowers social barriers.

name: Notoriety
description: Fame: minor local recognition that occasionally smooths social interactions.

name: Notoriety
description: Infamy: minor bad reputation that causes occasional friction in social situations.

name: Notoriety
description: Infamy: significant ill reputation that regularly impedes dealings with the general public.

name: Notoriety
description: Infamy: notorious villain — constantly recognized, feared, or opposed wherever they go.

name: Companions
description: A deeply bonded companion of equal skill — partner, lover, or best friend — who is a powerful ally.

name: Companions
description: A capable companion who provides significant, regular assistance and is emotionally important.

name: Companions
description: A minor companion — perhaps a trained animal or ward — who offers small, occasional help.

name: Companions
description: A companion whose needs cause occasional minor delays or require small sacrifices.

name: Companions
description: A companion who regularly requires significant care, creating serious ongoing demands.

name: Companions
description: A companion whose constant, pervasive needs dominate the character's life and decisions.
